# Third-Party Notices

<!-- Generated by scripts/check_licenses.py --write. Do not edit by hand. -->

`omm` is licensed under the [MIT License](LICENSE). This file lists the
third-party software that `omm` ships or bundles, and the license of each.
It is generated from installed package metadata and npm lockfiles by
`python scripts/check_licenses.py --write`; CI runs `--check` so it cannot go
stale. The verification process is described in
[docs/license-verification.md](docs/license-verification.md).

## npm launcher (`packaging/npm/launcher`)

The launcher has no third-party npm dependencies. Its optional dependencies
are the first-party `@omm-hippo/omm-*` platform packages, which contain the
standalone binary built from the Python packages listed above.

## Bundled runtime components

| Component | License | Where |
|---|---|---|
| CPython interpreter and standard library | PSF-2.0 | standalone npm and Windows portable binaries (PyInstaller) |
| OpenSSL (inside the cryptography wheel) | Apache-2.0 | standalone npm and Windows portable binaries |

## Recorded exceptions

Shipped packages that are not plainly permissive, and why they are accepted
(`scripts/license_policy.json`):

- `certifi` (MPL-2.0): File-level copyleft. omm uses the CA bundle unmodified, so only certifi's own files stay under MPL-2.0; the notice and license text travel with the package.
- `pyinstaller` (GPL-2.0-or-later WITH Bootloader-exception): The bootloader exception grants unlimited permission to embed the compiled bootloader and distribute the result under any terms. PyInstaller itself is not shipped or modified.
- `pyinstaller-hooks-contrib` (GPL-2.0-or-later AND Apache-2.0): Only the Apache-2.0 runtime hooks end up inside the binaries; the GPL hooks run on the build machine and are not distributed.

## Separately installed local runner applications

`omm` does not bundle or link these programs. It installs them through their
official channels or finds a copy the user installed, and talks to them as
separate processes. They keep their own licenses and terms.

| Application | License | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Ollama | MIT | https://github.com/ollama/ollama/blob/main/LICENSE |
| llama.cpp | MIT | https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/master/LICENSE |
| LM Studio | Proprietary (Element Labs terms) | https://lmstudio.ai/app-terms |
| Jan | Apache-2.0 | https://github.com/janhq/jan/blob/main/LICENSE |
| AnythingLLM | MIT | https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/blob/master/LICENSE |
| Msty Studio | Proprietary (Msty terms) | https://msty.ai/terms |
| KoboldCpp | AGPL-3.0 | https://github.com/LostRuins/koboldcpp/blob/concedo/LICENSE.md |
| text-generation-webui | AGPL-3.0 | https://github.com/oobabooga/text-generation-webui/blob/main/LICENSE |

Model weights downloaded by `omm` carry their own licenses (for example
Llama, Qwen, Gemma licenses). `omm info` shows the license reported by the
model source, and the local browser interface shows each model's license label.
